"""Author paragraph (b) four-lane, parked-vehicle controlled Native requests."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CASE = HERE.parent.parent
ROOT = CASE.parents[1]
POLICIES = {
    'primary': (8.0, 'standard', None),
    'fallback1': (7.0, 'standard', None),
    'fallback2': (8.0, 'elevated_overview', None),
    'fallback3': (8.0, 'standard', 45.0),
}
SOURCE = 'Upon a highway with unobstructed pavement which is not occupied by parked vehicles and which is of sufficient width for two or more lines of moving vehicles in each direction.'


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def put(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')


def put_rows(path, values):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n'
                            for row in values))


def road():
    lane = lambda ident, mark: (f'<lane id="{ident}" type="driving" level="false">'
        '<width sOffset="0" a="3.5" b="0" c="0" d="0"/>'
        f'<roadMark sOffset="0" type="{mark}" color="white" width="0.12"/></lane>')
    return ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n'
        '<OpenDRIVE><header revMajor="1" revMinor="4" '
        'name="C146314 paragraph b four moving lines" version="1.00" '
        'date="2026-11-08" north="8" south="-8" east="300" west="0" vendor="worker"/>'
        '<road name="four-lane authored pavement" length="300" id="211" junction="-1">'
        '<type s="0" type="town"><speed max="35" unit="mph"/></type>'
        '<planView><geometry s="0" x="0" y="0" hdg="0" length="300"><line/></geometry></planView>'
        '<lanes><laneSection s="0"><left>'+lane(1,'broken')+lane(2,'solid')+'</left>'
        '<center><lane id="0" type="none" level="false"><roadMark sOffset="0" '
        'type="solid" color="yellow" width="0.15"/></lane></center>'
        '<right>'+lane(-1,'broken')+lane(-2,'solid')+'</right></laneSection></lanes>'
        '<objects/><signals/></road></OpenDRIVE>\n')


def build():
    plan = json.loads((CASE/'case-plan.json').read_text())
    assignment = ROOT/'inputs'/CASE.name/'assignment.json'
    assert SOURCE in plan['source_law']['text']
    (HERE/'four-lane-pass.xodr').write_text(road())
    entries = []
    for witness, parked in (('exception_2_1', True), ('exception_2_2', False)):
        for candidate, (speed, camera, stop) in POLICIES.items():
            target = HERE/'drafts'/witness/candidate
            case_id = CASE.name+'__'+witness
            rows = []
            for i in range(240):
                t = (i+1)/20
                x = min(stop or 300, 5+speed*t)
                blend = max(0, min(1, (x-15)/20, (105-x)/20))
                y = -1.75-3.5*blend
                rows.append({
                    'frame': i, 'time_s': t,
                    'source_kind': 'authored_native_request',
                    'source_branch': 'NRS 484B.210(1)(b)',
                    'case_id': case_id, 'candidate_id': candidate,
                    'road_id': 211, 'ego_x_m': round(x,6), 'ego_y_m': round(y,6),
                    'ego_lane_id': -2 if y < -3.5 else -1,
                    'lead_x_m': round(35+4*t,6), 'lead_y_m': -1.75,
                    'lead_lane_id': -1,
                    'parked_vehicle_requested': parked,
                    'parked_x_m': 55 if parked else None,
                    'parked_y_m': -6.8 if parked else None,
                    'parked_lane_id': -2 if parked else None,
                    'four_driving_lanes_verified': False,
                    'parked_vehicle_observed': False,
                    'pavement_unobstructed_verified': False,
                    'actual_right_pass_observed': False,
                    'legal_verdict': None,
                })
            track = target/'requested-tracks.jsonl'
            put_rows(track, rows)
            cfg = {'format':'c146314-paragraph-b-request-v1',
                'assignment_id': CASE.name, 'case_id':case_id,
                'candidate_id':candidate, 'source_branch':'NRS 484B.210(1)(b)',
                'assignment_sha256':sha(assignment),
                'case_plan_sha256':sha(CASE/'case-plan.json'),
                'road_sha256':sha(HERE/'four-lane-pass.xodr'),
                'tracks_sha256':sha(track), 'rate_hz':20, 'frames':240,
                'requested_ego_speed_mps':speed, 'camera_policy':camera,
                'stop_x_m':stop, 'parked_vehicle_requested':parked,
                'four_driving_lanes_verified':False,
                'parked_vehicle_observed':False,
                'pavement_unobstructed_verified':False,
                'actual_right_pass_observed':False,
                'original_native_observed':False,
                'status':'unselected_native_request'}
            put(target/'config.json',cfg)
            entries.append({'case_id':case_id,'candidate_id':candidate,
                'config_sha256':sha(target/'config.json'),
                'tracks_sha256':sha(track),'status':'unselected_native_request'})
    manifest={'format':'c146314-paragraph-b-construction-v1',
        'assignment_id':CASE.name,'assignment_sha256':sha(assignment),
        'case_plan_sha256':sha(CASE/'case-plan.json'),
        'road_sha256':sha(HERE/'four-lane-pass.xodr'),
        'capture_sha256':sha(HERE/'capture.py'),
        'measurement_contract_sha256':sha(HERE/'measurement-contract.json'),
        'entries':entries,'original_native_observed':False,'delivery_ready':False}
    put(HERE/'manifest.json',manifest)
    return manifest


if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(json.dumps({'requests':len(build()['entries'])}))

"""Check exact paragraph (b) four-lane parked-vehicle request bundles."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from build import SOURCE


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def rows(path):
    return [json.loads(x) for x in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def check(bundle):
    bundle=Path(bundle)
    cfg=read(bundle/'config.json')
    plan=read(bundle/'case-plan.json')
    assignment=read(bundle/'assignment-source.json')
    source=plan['source_law']['text']
    require(source==assignment['law_record']['text'] and
        hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest()==
        '525f777bf701d9e420e3541071bc6b10de85f747a53fb044431e00826bfee06a'
        and SOURCE in source, 'frozen paragraph (b) source')
    road=ET.parse(bundle/'four-lane-pass.xodr').getroot()
    lanes=road.findall('./road/lanes/laneSection/left/lane')+road.findall(
        './road/lanes/laneSection/right/lane')
    require(road.find('./road').attrib['id']=='211' and
        {int(l.attrib['id']) for l in lanes}=={-2,-1,1,2} and
        all(l.attrib['type']=='driving' and float(l.find('width').attrib['a'])==3.5
            for l in lanes), 'four authored driving lines')
    track=rows(bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl')
    require(cfg['format']=='c146314-paragraph-b-request-v1' and
        cfg['assignment_sha256']==sha(bundle/'assignment-source.json') and
        cfg['case_plan_sha256']==sha(bundle/'case-plan.json') and
        cfg['road_sha256']==sha(bundle/'four-lane-pass.xodr') and
        cfg['tracks_sha256']==sha(bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl') and
        cfg['source_branch']=='NRS 484B.210(1)(b)' and
        cfg['candidate_id'] in ('primary','fallback1','fallback2','fallback3') and
        cfg['case_id'].endswith(('__exception_2_1','__exception_2_2')) and
        cfg['parked_vehicle_requested']==cfg['case_id'].endswith('__exception_2_1') and
        cfg['frames']==240 and cfg['rate_hz']==20 and len(track)==240 and
        cfg['status']=='unselected_native_request' and
        cfg['original_native_observed'] is False and
        all(cfg[key] is False for key in ('four_driving_lanes_verified',
            'parked_vehicle_observed','pavement_unobstructed_verified',
            'actual_right_pass_observed')), 'source-bound request config')
    speed=7 if cfg['candidate_id']=='fallback1' else 8
    stop=45 if cfg['candidate_id']=='fallback3' else None
    camera='elevated_overview' if cfg['candidate_id']=='fallback2' else 'standard'
    require(cfg['requested_ego_speed_mps']==speed and cfg['stop_x_m']==stop
        and cfg['camera_policy']==camera, 'distinct candidate policy')
    passing=0
    for i,row in enumerate(track):
        t=(i+1)/20
        x=min(stop or 300,5+speed*t)
        blend=max(0,min(1,(x-15)/20,(105-x)/20))
        y=-1.75-3.5*blend
        require(row['frame']==i and row['time_s']==t and
            row['source_kind']=='authored_native_request' and
            row['source_branch']=='NRS 484B.210(1)(b)' and
            row['case_id']==cfg['case_id'] and
            row['candidate_id']==cfg['candidate_id'] and
            row['road_id']==211 and
            math.isclose(row['ego_x_m'],x,abs_tol=1e-6) and
            math.isclose(row['ego_y_m'],y,abs_tol=1e-6) and
            row['ego_lane_id']==(-2 if y < -3.5 else -1) and
            math.isclose(row['lead_x_m'],35+4*t,abs_tol=1e-6) and
            row['lead_y_m']==-1.75 and row['lead_lane_id']==-1 and
            row['parked_vehicle_requested']==cfg['parked_vehicle_requested'] and
            row['parked_x_m']==(55 if cfg['parked_vehicle_requested'] else None) and
            row['parked_y_m']==(-6.8 if cfg['parked_vehicle_requested'] else None) and
            row['parked_lane_id']==(-2 if cfg['parked_vehicle_requested'] else None) and
            all(row[key] is False for key in ('four_driving_lanes_verified',
                'parked_vehicle_observed','pavement_unobstructed_verified',
                'actual_right_pass_observed')) and row['legal_verdict'] is None,
            f'request frame {i}')
        passing+=int(row['ego_x_m']>row['lead_x_m'] and row['ego_lane_id']==-2)
    require((passing==0)==(stop is not None), 'right-pass/stop split')
    return {'case_id':cfg['case_id'],'candidate_id':cfg['candidate_id'],
        'requested_right_ahead_frames':passing,
        'four_lanes_authored':True,'parked_vehicle_requested':
            cfg['parked_vehicle_requested'],
        'original_native_observed':False,'delivery_ready':False}


if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--bundle',required=True,type=Path)
    print(json.dumps(check(parser.parse_args().bundle)))

def repository():

        if (parent/'batch.json').is_file() and (parent/'runtime').is_dir():

def write_new(path,value):

        stream.write('\n')


def pose(actor):
    transform=actor.get_transform();velocity=actor.get_velocity()
    body=actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(transform)
    return {'actor_id':actor.id,'blueprint':actor.type_id,
        'center_native_xyz_m':[transform.location.x,transform.location.y,
                               transform.location.z],
        'yaw_deg':transform.rotation.yaw,
        'velocity_native_xyz_mps':[velocity.x,velocity.y,velocity.z],
        'speed_mps':math.sqrt(velocity.x**2+velocity.y**2+velocity.z**2),
        'body_native_xyz_m':[[p.x,p.y,p.z] for p in body]}


def steer_to(carla,actor,target_x,target_y,target_speed):
    transform=actor.get_transform();velocity=actor.get_velocity()
    speed=math.sqrt(velocity.x**2+velocity.y**2+velocity.z**2)
    if target_speed<=.05:
        return carla.VehicleControl(steer=0,throttle=0,
                                    brake=max(.5,min(1,speed)))
    angle=math.atan2(target_y-transform.location.y,
                     target_x-transform.location.x)
    error=math.atan2(math.sin(angle-math.radians(transform.rotation.yaw)),
                     math.cos(angle-math.radians(transform.rotation.yaw)))
    return carla.VehicleControl(steer=max(-.65,min(.65,1.4*error)),
        throttle=max(0,min(1,.2+.24*(target_speed-speed))),
        brake=max(0,min(1,.35*(speed-target_speed))))

                pwp=(None if obstruction is None else mapping.get_waypoint(
                    obstruction.get_location(),project_to_road=False,
                    lane_type=carla.LaneType.Driving))
                row={'frame':i,'native_frame':frame,'time_s':time_s,
                    'source_kind':'original_native',
                    'requested_ego_x_m':request['ego_x_m'],
                    'requested_ego_y_m':request['ego_y_m'],
                    'requested_lead_x_m':request['lead_x_m'],
                    'observed_ego_road_id':None if ewp is None else ewp.road_id,
                    'observed_ego_lane_id':None if ewp is None else ewp.lane_id,
                    'observed_lead_road_id':None if lwp is None else lwp.road_id,
                    'observed_lead_lane_id':None if lwp is None else lwp.lane_id,
                    'requested_parked_vehicle':cfg['parked_vehicle_requested'],
                    'observed_parked_road_id':None if pwp is None else pwp.road_id,
                    'observed_parked_lane_id':None if pwp is None else pwp.lane_id,
                    'ego':pose(ego),'lead':pose(lead),
                    'requested_lead_left_signal':lead_signal,
                    'observed_lead_light_state':int(lead.get_light_state()),
                    'observed_lead_left_blinker':bool(
                        lead.get_light_state() & carla.VehicleLightState.LeftBlinker),
                    'parked_vehicle':None if obstruction is None else pose(obstruction),
                    'four_driving_lanes_verified':True,
                    'pavement_condition_verified':False,
                    'legal_verdict':None}
                pipeline.capture(frame,time_s,extra={'c146314_paragraph_b_right_pass':row})
                observed.write(json.dumps(row,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
                for name,width,height,_,_ in cameras:
                    image=camera_queues[name].get(timeout=30)
                    while image.frame<frame:
                        image=camera_queues[name].get(timeout=30)
                    if image.frame!=frame:
                        raise RuntimeError('Native camera-frame join differs')
                    rgb=np.frombuffer(image.raw_data,dtype=np.uint8).reshape(
                        height,width,4)[:,:,:3][:,:,::-1]
                    videos[name].stdin.write(rgb.tobytes())
                frame_map.write(json.dumps({'video_frame':i,
                    'native_frame':frame,'time_s':time_s},
                    allow_nan=False)+'\n')
                frames+=1
    except BaseException as exc:
        error={'type':type(exc).__name__,'message':str(exc),
               'traceback':traceback.format_exc()}
    finally:
        if pipeline is not None:
            try:pipeline.close(confirmed=error is None)
            except BaseException as exc:
                error=error or {'pipeline_close_error':str(exc)}
        for name,process in videos.items():
            try:
                process.stdin.close()
                if process.wait(timeout=180)!=0:
                    raise RuntimeError('Lossless video encoder failed: '+name)
            except BaseException as exc:
                error=error or {'video_encoder_error':str(exc)}
            logs[name].close()
        for actor in reversed(owned):
            try:
                if actor.type_id.startswith('sensor.') and actor.is_listening:
                    actor.stop()
                actor.destroy()
            except BaseException as exc:
                error=error or {'cleanup_error':str(exc)}
        if changed:
            try:restored=restore(client,saved)
            except BaseException as exc:
                error=error or {'restore_error':str(exc)}
        write_new(output/'native-capture-report.json',{
            'case_id':checked['case_id'],'candidate_id':checked['candidate_id'],
            'config_sha256':sha(bundle/'config.json'),
            'requested_frames':240,'observed_frames':frames,
            'restoration':restored,'error':error,'accepted':False,
            'four_driving_lanes_verified':lanes_verified,
            'pavement_condition_verified':False,
            'parked_actor_spawned':obstruction is not None,
            'legal_verdict':None,'delivery_ready':False})
    if error:
        raise RuntimeError('C146314 Native attempt failed; see capture report')


if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--check',action='store_true')
    p.add_argument('--bundle',type=Path,default=Path.cwd())
    p.add_argument('--output-dir',type=Path)
    p.add_argument('--host',default='127.0.0.1')
    p.add_argument('--port',type=int,default=2000)
    a=p.parse_args()
    if a.check:
        print(json.dumps(check.check(a.bundle)))
    else:
        if a.output_dir is None:
            p.error('--output-dir is required outside --check')
        execute(a.bundle,a.output_dir,a.host,a.port)

"""Measure saved paragraph (b) bodies and parked occupancy without legal claims."""
import argparse
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from build import sha
from check import check


def read(path):return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
def rows(path):return [json.loads(s) for s in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]


def measure(bundle,saved):
    bundle=Path(bundle);saved=Path(saved)
    checked=check(bundle);cfg=read(bundle/'config.json')
    receipt=read(saved/'readback.json')
    if not (receipt['source_kind']=='synthetic_cpu' and
        receipt['config_sha256']==sha(bundle/'config.json') and
        receipt['tracks_sha256']==sha(bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl') and
        receipt['road_sha256']==sha(bundle/'four-lane-pass.xodr') and
        receipt['native_observed_sha256']==sha(saved/'native-observed.jsonl') and
        receipt['camera_frames_sha256']==sha(saved/'camera-frames.jsonl') and
        receipt['frames']==240 and receipt['original_native_observed'] is False and
        receipt['human_video_reviewed'] is False and receipt['delivery_ready'] is False):
        raise ValueError('saved paragraph (b) source binding')
    tracks=rows(bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl')
    observed=rows(saved/'native-observed.jsonl')
    cameras=rows(saved/'camera-frames.jsonl')
    if not(len(tracks)==len(observed)==len(cameras)==240):
        raise ValueError('saved frame count')
    pass_frames=parked_frames=reviewed_frames=0
    for i,(request,row,camera) in enumerate(zip(tracks,observed,cameras)):
        if not(row['frame']==camera['frame']==i and
            row['time_s']==camera['time_s']==request['time_s'] and
            row['source_kind']==camera['source_kind']=='synthetic_cpu' and
            camera['forward_frame']==camera['overview_frame']==i and
            camera['camera_policy']==cfg['camera_policy'] and
            camera['human_reviewed'] is False and
            row['ego_actor_id']==101 and row['lead_actor_id']==102 and
            row['ego_road_id']==row['lead_road_id']==211 and
            row['ego_lane_id']==request['ego_lane_id'] and
            row['lead_lane_id']==-1 and
            row['ego_center_xy_m']==[request['ego_x_m'],request['ego_y_m']] and
            row['lead_center_xy_m']==[request['lead_x_m'],request['lead_y_m']] and
            row['pavement_unobstructed_verified'] is False and
            row['legal_verdict'] is None):
            raise ValueError(f'saved frame join {i}')
        for name in ('ego','lead'):
            x,y=row[name+'_center_xy_m'];body=row[name+'_body_xy_m']
            if body!=[[round(x+dx,6),round(y+dy,6)] for dx,dy in
                ((-2,-.9),(-2,.9),(2,.9),(2,-.9))]:
                raise ValueError(f'{name} body {i}')
        parked=cfg['parked_vehicle_requested']
        if not(row['parked_actor_id']==(103 if parked else None) and
            row['parked_center_xy_m']==([55,-6.8] if parked else None) and
            row['parked_speed_mps']==(0 if parked else None) and
            row['parked_lane_id']==(-2 if parked else None) and
            row['parked_pixels_reviewed'] is False and
            row['lane_pixels_reviewed'] is False):
            raise ValueError(f'parked observation {i}')
        if parked:
            x,y=row['parked_center_xy_m']
            if row['parked_body_xy_m']!=[[round(x+dx,6),round(y+dy,6)]
                for dx,dy in ((-2,-.9),(-2,.9),(2,.9),(2,-.9))]:
                raise ValueError(f'parked body {i}')
        elif row['parked_body_xy_m'] is not None:
            raise ValueError(f'unexpected parked body {i}')
        ego=row['ego_body_xy_m'];lead=row['lead_body_xy_m']
        pass_frames+=int(min(p[0] for p in ego)>max(p[0] for p in lead)
            and all(-7<=p[1]<=-3.5 for p in ego))
        parked_frames+=int(parked and row['parked_body_xy_m'] is not None)
        reviewed_frames+=int(row['parked_pixels_reviewed'] and row['lane_pixels_reviewed'])
    return {'format':'c146314-paragraph-b-saved-measurement-v1',
        'case_id':checked['case_id'],'candidate_id':checked['candidate_id'],
        'frames':240,'full_body_right_pass_frames':pass_frames,
        'synthetic_parked_body_frames':parked_frames,
        'human_reviewed_condition_frames':reviewed_frames,
        'source_kind':'synthetic_cpu','original_native_observed':False,
        'pavement_unobstructed_verified':False,'legal_verdict':None,
        'delivery_ready':False}


if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--bundle',type=Path,required=True)
    p.add_argument('--saved',type=Path,required=True);a=p.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(measure(a.bundle,a.saved)))

import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from check import check
from measure_saved import measure
from route_fallbacks import route

class ExactParagraphB(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_four_lane_parked_source(self):
        result=check(Path.cwd())
        self.assertTrue(result['four_lanes_authored'])
        self.assertFalse(result['original_native_observed'])
        self.assertFalse(result['delivery_ready'])

    def test_right_pass_or_stop(self):
        result=check(Path.cwd())
        if result['candidate_id']=='fallback3':
            self.assertEqual(result['requested_right_ahead_frames'],0)
        else:
            self.assertGreater(result['requested_right_ahead_frames'],0)

    def test_synthetic_saved_measurement(self):
        result=measure(Path.cwd(),Path.cwd()/'saved')
        self.assertEqual(result['frames'],240)
        self.assertEqual(result['human_reviewed_condition_frames'],0)
        self.assertFalse(result['delivery_ready'])

    def test_measured_fallback_eligibility(self):
        result=route(Path.cwd(),Path.cwd()/'saved')
        self.assertEqual(set(result['triggers']),
                         {'fallback1','fallback2','fallback3'})
        self.assertIsNone(result['selected_fallback'])
